column1: # Reserves a 6 MB "model" partition that esp-sr's CMakeLists.txt looks
# for by name; when present it auto-packs the selected WakeNet/MultiNet
# models into build/srmodels/srmodels.bin and adds it to `idf.py flash`.
# Sized per the esp-sr flash-model doc's default recommendation (models
# only take ~130 KB for WakeNet Hi ESP
# adding MultiNet command sets without repartitioning + reflashing).
# Factory app grows to 2 MB (was 1.5 MB in SINGLE_APP_LARGE preset) to
# comfortably fit esp32-camera + wifi + http_server + esp-sr AFE side-
